physical_scope: Exact saved raw values/UID/geometry; replay relocates bindings without resampling, mapping or trimming. Nominal resistor values only; profile-excluded effects remain excluded.

plan.contrast_reasons: An 8 mV MAE reduction asks whether the extra 0.664 um2 over A37 buys a substantial fraction of the 25 mV half-window. At equal 3.7 um2, 5 mV distinguishes a useful allocation preference (20 percent of that half-window). The broad R37 comparison asks for at least 20 mV benefit; finer precision would not change that baseline decision. These are engineering decision thresholds, not a power or yield specification.
plan.exposure: New physical targets use the already fixed new seed, indices 100..697. Development 0..23 and every old first-study/passive observation remain known. Nominal and 0.97-V settings are known conditions; the fresh element is the unexposed saved physical realization, not a newly discovered environmental value. No seed restart, redraw or latent selection.
plan.function: Unchanged first-study gain -6, output 0.5 V, input 0.45 V, 1 kohm source, 100 kohm || 1 pF load, 26.85 C, VDD nominal 1 V / changed 0.97 V. Original center/gain/bandwidth/current/signal limits remain fixed.
plan.measurements: Existing ads.gain-study.v1 DC/AC/current definitions. Keep uniform five-test DC/AC/current outcome separate from additional nominal sine checks on indices 100 and 101. No Local noise population claim.
plan.paired_mapping: The same seed/index/stable UID gives identical standardized coordinates. New geometry changes sigma and the mapped physical raw device, so common coordinates do not mean identical complete physical samples.
plan.prediction: Before any circuit target: nominal raw Jacobian plus already measured supply slope. Use saved physical raw values after independent reference mapping, with no target-OP input or circuit correction.
plan.public_replay_selection: Before targets: AL37W index 100 nominal and supply_097, AR37 index 100 nominal. Publish/replay even if they fail the specification; no showcase selection by outcome.
plan.question: Does output-load area allocation beat the finite matched-area alternatives by a useful untrimmed voltage-MAE amount, and does the improvement survive the known supply change while remaining worse than the matched-current R37 baseline?
plan.resources: AL37W/AR37/AI37/AB37 have the same 3.7 um2 drawn MOS and 37.5 uA nominal total current, within 30 kohm internal-resistance ceiling. A37 and R37 use 3.0365 and 3.5367 um2: matched-current/common-ceiling baselines, not matched-area claims. All ideal source/load dependencies count; their physical generator implementation cost is unspecified.

sample_size.derivation: Smallest common integer n satisfying t_(1-0.05/(2*10),n-1) * (1.25 * development paired SD) / sqrt(n) <= 3 mV for allocation comparisons, <= 8 mV for the broad R37 comparison. Inflation of 1.25 is a declared pilot-uncertainty allowance, not a guarantee or a formal upper confidence limit. Precision, not a claim of fixed power to prove the minimum effect.

plan.sine_scope: Only indices 100 and 101 at nominal receive the additional original 5-mV/10-kHz sine check. This is a bounded prospective signal sanity check, not population distortion qualification; uniform DC/AC/current pass stays separate.
plan.source_profile: Pinned APM v5.0.0 APM045 VTG Local; no passive/spatial/foundry statistics added.
plan.statistical_rule: For every stated contrast in both conditions, paired absolute-error difference; positive favors the right candidate. Ten Bonferroni paired t intervals jointly at approximate 95 percent family coverage. Lower bound > 0 supports nonzero improvement; > stated useful effect supports that minimum. Overlap with a threshold is inconclusive for that threshold. No target-based extension or recentering.
plan.stopping: Prepare exactly 3588 saved circuit realizations / 16744 units, then attempt 7176 circuit conditions once. Keep unresolved, numerical failures, unsupported cases and valid physical failures in assignment counts. Use only common usable/supported pairs for numeric loss intervals, disclose the missing denominator; if more than 1 percent are missing in a contrast, limit conclusions to observed cases and do not claim the full sampled model comparison. Three consecutive numerical failures stop for bounded diagnosis. No trim, rebias, recentering, redraw, relaxed limits, outcome-driven sample/candidate extension or optional stopping.
